topic: Protection and location of flight data recorder
syllabus_extract: Protection and location of flight data recorder.
specific_objectives: 15.1.11.4 Trainee will be able to explain Protection and location of FDR.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of FDR installation diagrams in IB; Instructor supervision required for diagram interpretation.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the Flight Data Recorder?
Where is the FDR typically located on a commercial aircraft?
Why is the FDR often painted orange?

development.content:
FDR physical protection mechanisms
Crash survivability requirements
Environmental sealing standards
Impact resistance specifications

Standard FDR installation locations
Tail cone mounting procedures
Fire protection systems
Access panel configurations

Regulatory compliance for FDR
Maintenance access protocols
Data integrity safeguards
Post-accident recovery procedures

summary_questions: Explain how the FDR protects data during a crash event.
Describe the typical location of the FDR relative to the aircraft center of gravity.
What measures ensure the FDR remains operational after fire exposure?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the knowledge of FDR protection and location will assist in future troubleshooting of aircraft black box systems during LP 02.
